status: INDICATIVE — engineering defaults for the academic prototype. Validate every product, dose and interval against the product label and a local agronomist before any field use.
dosage_unit: mL of prepared spray mix per plant

protectant_fungicide.description: Protectant (contact) fungicide, e.g. chlorothalonil- or mancozeb-class product

late_blight_fungicide.description: Oomycete-targeted fungicide programme for late blight (Phytophthora infestans)

low.reason: Early blight below 20% leaf area — monitor, re-survey before treating.

medium.reason: Early blight 20–50% leaf area — standard protectant dose.

high.reason: Early blight above 50% leaf area — high protectant dose.

low.reason: Late blight spreads fast — any infection is treated at full dose.

medium.reason: Late blight spreads fast — any infection is treated at full dose.

high.reason: Late blight spreads fast — any infection is treated at full dose.

low.reason: Septoria below 20% leaf area — monitor, re-survey before treating.

medium.reason: Septoria 20–50% leaf area — medium protectant dose.

high.reason: Septoria above 50% leaf area — high protectant dose.
